limitations: Shared inherited guidance makes this exploratory evidence.
UTC observations were captured inside tool commands; exact first-tool start and final handoff duration were not measured.
Token telemetry and API billing were unavailable.
Only the released kiln stage2 requirement and own stage1 application were read during this stage; earlier requirements were already present in context.
No results, acceptance or other-track files were read and no scored feedback was supplied.
The single local batch covers the finite state-operation matrix but is not exhaustive input or filesystem verification.
Provider outputs retain the base expectation of UUID-v4 and UTC ISO timestamp strings; provider exceptions are not assigned a contract error.
No concurrency, distributed IO or migrations are implemented.
